title: chrysanthemum carnosulum
intro: Chrysanthemum carnosulum, commonly known as Korean chrysanthemum, is a type of flowering plant in the daisy family. It has been traditionally used in herbal medicine to treat various health conditions due to its numerous health benefits, including reducing inflammation, improving digestion, and boosting the immune system. The therapeutic actions of this plant are attributed to its ability to act as an anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antiviral agent, making it a potential remedy for various ailments. The bioactive constituents of Chrysanthemum carnosulum include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
